QuestInfo.name: Snow Witch
QuestInfo.1: After hearing about Scadur, Alcaster told you about the Snow Witch. He says if you bring an #b#t4000415##k from the #bSnow Witch#k, he would make a talisman for Scadur that would allow him to hide from the Snow Witch. Defeat the Snow Witch and bring an ice fragment to Alcaster.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You have delivered an Ice Tear to Alcaster.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 18,813\n\nCan proceed to the 'Alcaster's Talisman' quest

0.0: I am Alcaster, the magician of this town. Tell me, what brings you here?
0.1: Hm... So that's why Scadur hasn't been hunting. Unfortunately, I can't eliminate the Snow Witch with my power... But I can hide Scadur from the Snow Witch.
0.2: To do so, I need an #bIce Tear#k, which can be obtained from the #bSnow Witch#k. Beware, it will be challenging for you to defeat the Snow Witch on your own... What do you say? Can you do it?

yes.0: Scadur is right. You can find the Snow Witch in the #bIcy Cold Field#k. If you think it'll be too challenging to defeat her by yourself, gather a few more people to help you. In any case, all you have to do is bring the Ice Tear back to me.

no.0: So, it is too challenging. Well, come back if you feel bold.

item.0: Bring me an #bIce Tear#k from the #bSnow Witch#k. If it seems too challenging, I recommend going with a few more people.
